risks.title: VPS accepts tactical records without the configured unique key
risks.consequence: Records without identity cannot be deduplicated reliably and may inflate tactical collections.
compensatingControls: SLF client contracts require snapshotKey, resultKey, eventKey, or effectKey
append responses report missingUniqueKey
analysis health reports missingUniqueKeys
contract and compatibility tests cover the current behaviour
risks.target: Reject missing tactical identity before persistence after producer compatibility verification and a separately tested deployment change.
risks.closureEvidence: vps/api/server.py rejects any tactical append missing the configured unique key with HTTP 400 kind=missing_unique_key before persistence (fail-closed, no partial writes); regression tests vps/api/test_server.py (test_missing_unique_key_is_rejected_before_persistence, test_mixed_append_with_missing_key_is_rejected_without_partial_write) and tools/test-api-contract-compatibility.py; all SLF producers verified to always send snapshotKey/resultKey/eventKey/effectKey; docs/contracts/versioned-data-api-contracts.md updated. VPS deployment remains a separate operational boundary (deploy-code.sh + verify_api_deployment.py).

risks.title: VPS API has no explicit request-body size limit
risks.consequence: Oversized authenticated requests can consume memory, CPU, and storage.
compensatingControls: API requires bearer authentication
CI fuzz payloads are bounded
deployment remains private operational infrastructure
risks.target: Introduce a reviewed MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH and negative tests with an explicit operational limit.
risks.closureEvidence: vps/api/server.py sets MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH = 1 MiB and returns JSON 413 kind=payload_too_large with limitBytes for oversized bodies; regression test test_oversized_request_body_is_rejected in vps/api/test_server.py. VPS deployment remains a separate operational boundary.

risks.title: VPS API CORS policy is broad
risks.consequence: Unexpected browser origins may attempt authenticated API access if a token is exposed to that origin.
compensatingControls: Bearer token is stored in Tampermonkey storage
token is sent only in the Authorization header
userscript connection hosts are allowlisted
risks.target: Define and test explicit allowed origins without breaking Tampermonkey transport.
risks.closureEvidence: vps/api/server.py restricts CORS to explicit SLF origins (https://slf.fm, https://www.slf.fm, https://soccerlife.ru, https://www.soccerlife.ru); regression test test_cors_allows_explicit_origins_only in vps/api/test_server.py. VPS deployment remains a separate operational boundary.

risks.title: External jQuery userscript dependency is URL-versioned but not content-addressed
risks.consequence: A compromised external distribution path could change executed dependency bytes without a repository diff.
compensatingControls: The dependency URL is fixed to jQuery 3.6.0
The exact @require allowlist is merge-blocking
Release evidence records the declared external requirement
risks.target: Remove the dependency, vendor a reviewed licensed copy, or add content-digest verification to release evidence.
risks.closureEvidence: jQuery 3.6.0 vendored at vendor/jquery-3.6.0.min.js (sha256 ff1523fb7389539c84c65aba19260648793bb4f5e29329d2ee8804bc37a3fe6e, fetched from code.jquery.com on 2026-08-17) with vendor/jquery-3.6.0.LICENSE.txt (MIT); @require now points to the repository release URL; tools/test-security-boundaries.mjs pins the vendored digest and license and keeps the @require allowlist merge-blocking.

risks.title: Browser DOM XSS coverage is not yet sink-complete
risks.boundary: Untrusted page and API text to userscript UI
risks.consequence: An unsafe render path could execute or inject attacker-controlled markup in the SLF page context.
compensatingControls: Dynamic code execution sinks are prohibited
Browser E2E executes the exact artifact and fails on runtime exceptions
Security scan inventories innerHTML assignments
risks.target: Classify every innerHTML assignment and add malicious-string fixtures for all untrusted data paths.
risks.closureEvidence: All 39 innerHTML assignments classified (trusted / escaped / unescaped) in the QR-005 audit; the single unescaped sink src/app/ui-layer.js:142 (save dialog preset names from localStorage/VPS) now escapes both key and label via UI.escapeHtml; malicious-string browser fixture tests/browser/test_save_dialog_xss_fixtures.py (registered in quality-integration.yml browser-e2e) proves payloads are escaped and do not execute; tools/test-security-boundaries.mjs keeps the innerHTML inventory merge-blocking.

risks.title: Component workflows are path-filtered and cannot safely be required individually
risks.consequence: A skipped path-filtered workflow can leave a required status context pending and block unrelated merges.
compensatingControls: All prerequisite quality workflows are integrated into main
The rollout manifest requires an always-running aggregate check before protection is enabled
Branch protection remains explicitly not enforced until the aggregate context is observed
risks.target: Create and observe the exact aggregate status context, then configure and verify branch protection with a disposable pull request.
risks.closureEvidence: protect-main ruleset (id 20537936) is active on refs/heads/main with the always-running aggregate SLF CI / ci status check, conversation resolution, and deletion/force-push protection; verified with a disposable pull request (aggregateVerification runId 31135537375) before enabling protection.

risks.title: No independent reviewer is currently available for critical repository changes
risks.consequence: The same maintainer can author requirements, implementation, tests, and approval, increasing the chance that a shared mistaken assumption passes every internal check.
compensatingControls: Owner acceptance is recorded explicitly and never described as independent review
Exact artifact, contract, security, browser E2E, property, fuzz, mutation, reliability, and provenance gates are integrated
Critical unresolved assumptions must remain in the risk register with review dates
Production deployment and branch-protection changes require separate explicit owner actions
Failures and skipped checks cannot be silently reclassified as successful review
risks.target: Use an independent qualified reviewer when one becomes available and reassess whether approval requirements can be increased.
risks.acceptance: Repository owner explicitly accepted this single-maintainer risk on 2026-08-04.

risks.title: Pull requests can modify CI workflow definitions without a required approving review
risks.consequence: A pull request can change quality-integration.yml or other workflow definitions and merge without an approving review, allowing CI logic to be altered by the same single maintainer who authors the change.
compensatingControls: protect-main ruleset requires the always-running aggregate SLF CI / ci status check on every pull request
The release gate re-validates the exact merged main source with independent provenance checks before publication
Deterministic rebuild and artifact digest verification detect non-source changes in release outputs
CODEOWNERS requires owner review for /.github/ changes
QR-007 records the single-maintainer acceptance model
risks.target: Increase required approving reviews when an independent reviewer becomes available; until then keep the aggregate status check and release-gate revalidation as compensating controls.
risks.acceptance: Repository owner explicitly accepted this single-maintainer CI self-modification risk on 2026-08-17.

risks.title: Release branch direct pushes cannot be gated by pull-request or force-push rules in a user-owned repository
risks.consequence: The automated SLF Release workflow must push generated release commits directly to the release branch. GitHub does not allow the GitHub Actions application as a ruleset bypass actor in user-owned repositories, so pull-request and non-fast-forward rules would block legitimate publication. The release branch therefore allows direct pushes by repository write access.
compensatingControls: protect-release ruleset blocks release branch deletion
SLF Maintenance drift check verifies the release tip is a generated release commit whose approvedCommit is an ancestor of main and that manifest, user.js and meta.js versions match
The release workflow uses force-with-lease pinned to the observed release ref and refuses stale publication
The release gate re-validates the exact merged main source before publication
Only the repository owner has write access (single maintainer, QR-007)
risks.target: Re-evaluate when GitHub supports the Actions application as a bypass actor for user-owned repositories, or when an independent reviewer and stricter approval model become available.
risks.acceptance: Repository owner explicitly accepted this platform limitation on 2026-08-17.
